hotspots.title: AfD party congress protests
hotspots.blurb: Massive protests erupted in Erfurt, Germany, as the far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) held its party congress. Over 50,000 demonstrators blocked roads and clashed with police, while AfD re-elected its leadership duo, Alice Weidel and Tino Chrupalla, amid rising poll numbers.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to the high-stakes confrontation between far-right politics and widespread public opposition, framed as a moral and democratic crisis.

hotspots.title: PP-Vox coalition in Andalusia
hotspots.blurb: The conservative People's Party (PP) and far-right Vox formed a coalition government in Andalusia, Spain, after weeks of negotiations. The deal includes 150 policy measures, such as prioritizing Spanish nationals for public aid and rejecting unaccompanied migrant minors.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to the normalization of far-right policies in mainstream governance, sparking moral panic over democratic backsliding and social exclusion.
